# Independent Olivia interoperability fixture

`olivia4-2000-fldigi.s16le` contains 30,736 mono signed little-endian PCM samples
at 8,000 Hz. It was generated by the **upstream FLDigi transmitter**, not the
DataPump transmitter. The text is `CQ CQ TEST 123 Hello world` followed by LF.
There are sixteen idle NUL characters before and after the text. Each float
sample was clipped to [-1, 1], scaled by 32760, and rounded to signed 16-bit.
SHA-256: `acc23b25b9d565515ccaf00c996fdad9bdfdbd9750d2e2754341734534960063`.

The reference is the [FLDigi source mirror at revision
61b97f4133c488063f3de1795c894d22d5032e8a](https://github.com/w1hkj/fldigi/tree/61b97f4133c488063f3de1795c894d22d5032e8a),
specifically `src/include/jalocha/pj_mfsk.h` and its header dependencies.
The header SHA-256 is
`2bc425dbb4fdf7ef89f59975403e21cbe517665ffd8f1c64eb7730db12977fae`.
The fixture was produced on Linux/glibc with GCC 14 and `srand(1)`; a different
platform's C random generator may produce different valid symbol phases.
No upstream implementation is incorporated in DataPump.

The optional `olivia_reference.cpp` runner produces this fixture, prints the
two independent 64-tone vectors asserted in `test_legacy_olivia.cpp`, and checks
both PCM directions against the actual reference transmitter and receiver. From
the DataPump root, with an independently obtained FLDigi checkout:

```sh
g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -Iinclude -I/path/to/fldigi/src/include/jalocha \
  src/legacy/olivia.cpp tests/fixtures/legacy/olivia_reference.cpp \
  -o /tmp/olivia-reference
/tmp/olivia-reference /tmp/olivia4-2000-fldigi.s16le
```

Both directions returned the exact text on 2026-09-19. The upstream receive
settings were four tones, 2,000 Hz bandwidth, 1,500 Hz center, four-block
integration and `SyncThreshold=8`. Its default threshold of three produced
extra characters at clean signal startup/shutdown, including an independent
upstream-transmitter to upstream-receiver control. Raising the threshold to
eight removed those extras in the DataPump-to-FLDigi check. This is sampled
software interoperability evidence, not a radio, sound-device, or fading-channel
performance claim.

The ordinary regression suite requires only the checked-in PCM fixture. It
checks decoding with arbitrary push boundaries, additive noise, sample timing,
carrier adjustment, real-time callbacks, and noise-only rejection. Product code
implements the [published Olivia modulation and coding specification](https://www.arrl.org/olivia)
independently: 500-baud Gray-coded 4-FSK, overlapping raised-cosine symbols,
64-symbol Walsh coding, diagonal bit interleaving, and the standard scrambler.
